title: private-deployments-weekly-2026-08-10
content:
Private Deployments — Weekly update (week of 2026-08-10)
Owner: Ava Patel
Summary:
- Focus this week on three active customer installs (Acme, Nebula Health, FinServCo), VPC peering variability, and finishing the airgap packaging for on-prem nodes.
- Several network/firewall-related blockers are dominating time; we also opened a KMS integration investigation for FinServCo due to HSM policy requirements.

Standup notes / Highlights:
1) Acme (on-prem)
   - Current status: Installer runs to completion but runtime fails on startup with cert validation errors and inability to reach metrics endpoint.
   - Root cause (investigating): Customer's proxy rewrites TLS SNI and strips client cert header; also discovered missing root CA in our agent bundle.
   - Action taken: Sent a patched agent that includes alternate CA bundle and additional logging (PD-1423). Scheduled remote debug session Thu 2026-08-13 09:00 PDT with Acme infra team.
   - Blocker: Customer legal is slow to approve SSH jumpbox access; workaround waiting on screen-sharing debug.

2) Nebula Health (VPC, AWS, GovCloud-like setup)
   - Current status: VPC peering established, but cross-account routing dropped packets intermittently (sporadic timeouts for model pulls).
   - Diagnosis: Route table propagation inconsistent after peering; likely due to policy-based routing on customer's Transit Gateway.
   - Action: Provided a small script to validate route propagation and a checklist for their network team. Next step: pairing call with Nebula’s cloud infra Fri 2026-08-14.

3) FinServCo (private with HSM/KMS)
   - Current status: HSM onboarding requires PKCS#11 support and an additional key-wrapping flow we don't currently exercise in the private agent.
   - Risk: Delaying go-live until HSM path is certified (~2-3 weeks estimated).
   - Action: Eng-sre + applied-ml working on a lightweight shim to support PKCS#11 calls in the agent; prototype PR opened (GH PR #567).
   - Blocker: Compliance requires an audit of our key usage patterns — need security review scheduled next week.

Operational / Infra items:
- Airgap packaging: QA passed for Linux x86 build; remaining tasks: Windows installer tests and offline dependency verification. ETA: 2026-08-17.
- Telemetry gap: Several installs are missing platform-level heartbeats due to agent failing to write aggregated metrics to the configured S3 endpoint when behind proxy. Investigating a retry/backoff fix.
- Node autoscaling on private clusters: Hit an edge case where burst scale-down interferes with model warmup. Repro steps and mitigation documented; feature-fix targeted for sprint 2026-08-24.

Recent meeting notes (customer syncs & internal):
- 2026-08-11 — Acme sync: walked through patched agent logs; found two additional NTP skew issues on customer hosts causing cert validity checks to fail intermittently. Action: added clock-sync check to installer preflight.
- 2026-08-12 — Internal KMS sync with security: agreed on audit scope and temporary mitigation of using customer-managed encryption-on-rest until PKCS#11 shim is validated. Security will assign a reviewer (expected by 2026-08-18).
- 2026-08-12 — Infra weekly: landed small optimization to model pull backoff which should reduce bandwidth spikes during initial node boot.

Blockers (high priority):
- SSH access for Acme debugging (owner: Diego Martinez) — blocker until legal approves (Jira: PD-1423).
- PKCS#11 shim for FinServCo (owner: Marcus Nguyen) — blocks go-live; prototype PR open and needs review/qa.
- Transit Gateway routing flakiness for Nebula (owner: Sofia Kim) — depends on customer's network team schedule.

Action items and owners:
- Diego: follow up with Acme legal for SSH approval, escalate to CSM if no response by 2026-08-14.
- Marcus: iterate on PKCS#11 shim PR, add unit tests for key-wrapping flow, aim to merge by 2026-08-18.
- Sofia: run pairing with Nebula network team + collect full traceroute and route table snapshots on 2026-08-14.
- Ava: update runbook for on-prem preflight (add clock-sync, CA bundle checks) and publish to Confluence.
- Eng-sre: implement telemetry retry/backoff patch and roll to canary private installs (target 2026-08-16).

Notes / Risks:
- Customer friction around legal/ops access is our largest time sink; consider a standard 'screen-share only' debug SLA to unblock installs while legal completes paperwork.
- HSM/KMS compliance timelines are uncertain; propose an interim customer-managed-encryption configuration for sales to use as mitigation in proposals.

Runbook updates this week:
- Preflight checklist: added clock-sync, CA bundle verification, proxy header expectations.
- Debugging playbook: added steps for packet-capture collection behind Transit Gateway, and quick commands to validate route propagation.

Requests / asks to other teams:
- Solutions Engineering: please provide a template email that customer success can send to legal teams to speed SSH/jumpbox approvals.
- Security: expedited review of PKCS#11 shim and audit scope (owner: security team, contact: security-review@redwood.ai).

Metrics / health:
- Mean time to resolve (active installs this month): 7.4 days (target <5).
- Number of active private installs: 9 (3 in active debug state).
- Telemetry coverage: ~82% of installs reporting full metrics (goal 95%).

Next week plan (2026-08-17 to 2026-08-21):
- Merge and QA PKCS#11 shim; if green, begin staging FinServCo onboarding.
- Finish airgap Windows installer tests and finalize offline dependency manifest.
- Continue paired troubleshooting with Nebula and Acme; aim to close at least one of the three active installs.

Internal notes / quick todo (informal):
- Need to document the "screen-share only" debug option in CSM playbook.
- Add a checklist item to sales proposal templates for KMS/HSM expectations.
- Remind product to include a small flag in future agent builds to surface low-level TLS handshake errors (can help customer debugging).

Attachments / links: see linked_artifacts above for Jira, Confluence, and GH PR.

-- end of weekly update
